subject: Handoff velocity map + evaluation checkpoints — post-signature rollout (Elysian Labs)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Kate Morales <kate.morales@elysianlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff velocity map + evaluation checkpoints — post-signature rollout (Elysian Labs)

Hi Kate,

Congrats on signing — excited to get Elysian set up. Attached is a concise mutual-action sketch so we can align on the post-signature rollout, canary window, migration sequence, and training cadence. High-level asks from us:

- Confirm target go-live week (you mentioned mid-June during the call)
- Point person for SRE/infra test access (we need a short-lived permit for canarying)
- Acceptance criteria for the evaluation plan (success metrics we’ll gate on for canary)

I’ve copied Marissa and Ben — Marissa will drive the MAP and training schedule; Ben will own the migration/backout checklist. If mid-June still works, our proposed timeline in the attachment does a two-week staged canary (dark traffic → 1% → 10% → ramp) with training in week zero and a fallback window in week two.

Can you confirm: who from your side should be on the weekly 30-min syncs, and are there any blackout dates we should avoid for the canary?

Thanks,

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0129

Attachments: ELY-5921_MAP_v1.xlsx, canary-window-proposal.pdf
From: Kate Morales <kate.morales@elysianlabs.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@elysianlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff velocity map + evaluation checkpoints — post-signature rollout (Elysian Labs)

Thanks Priyom — and congrats team. A few quick items from our side:

- Mid-June still looks feasible; target week June 17–21.
- SRE contact: Samir (cc’d) will own the short-term test role and can provide a jumpbox account scoped to the canary range.
- Acceptance criteria: we need 99.5% successful inference responses (no more than 0.5% 5xx), P95 latency < 350ms for the 2k token profile, and no data egress beyond our VPC during testing.

Training: we’d like two sessions — an operator runbook walkthrough and a developer workshop. Operator session should be limited to SRE + ops (up to 6 people); developer session can be broader. We’ll share preferred dates for June 3–7 for runbook walkthroughs.

Blackout: we have a company-wide migration on June 10, so please avoid the week of June 10–14.

Samir — can you confirm the list of ports/services you’ll need opened and whether a temporary VPN user is required?

Best,
Kate
Kate Morales
Head of Ops | Elysian Labs
kate.morales@elysianlabs.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kate Morales <kate.morales@elysianlabs.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff velocity map + evaluation checkpoints — post-signature rollout (Elysian Labs)

Kate, Priyom — thanks for the clarity. I pushed a cleaned-up MAP into the attached spreadsheet (ELY-5921_MAP_v1.xlsx) and pulled out the evaluation checkpoints so we have concrete gating steps. Summary highlights (copied from the sheet):

1) Week -2 (June 3–7): Training week
   - Tue 6/4 10:00 PT — Operator runbook & incident playbook (SRE + ops, invite only)
   - Thu 6/6 11:00 PT — Developer workshop (larger audience)
   - Deliverable: training roster (training-roster.csv) and signed acknowledgment from SRE lead

2) Week -1 (June 17 start): Canary execution (note blackout 6/10–6/14)
   - Day 0: Dark traffic validation + baseline metrics collection (24h)
   - Day 1–3: 1% traffic for 24–72h with daily smoke tests
   - Day 4–6: 10% traffic with evaluation checkpoints at P95 and error rate windows
   - Exit criteria: meet acceptance thresholds (Kate’s metrics) for two consecutive checkpoint windows

3) Week +1: Staged migration and ramp to 50% then 100% (with automated rollback on threshold breach)

4) Contingency: we hold a recovery window 6/24–6/26 where our infra team can execute rollback and audits if needed.

Ben: I’ve added the migration checklist to the sheet (see attachment). Priyom — I’ll own the two training invites once Kate confirms attendee lists.

On the VPN/jumpbox question — Samir, whenever you confirm required IPs/ports we’ll coordinate with infra to provision a scoped jumpbox and ephemeral keys.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: ELY-5921_MAP_v1.xlsx, training-roster.csv
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@elysianlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kate Morales <kate.morales@elysianlabs.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 07:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff velocity map + evaluation checkpoints — post-signature rollout (Elysian Labs)

Hi all — quick technical clarifications from Elysian infra:

- We can provide a scoped jumpbox; prefer that Redwood uses SSH with MFA. We will need a list of Redwood public keys by 6/3.
- Ports: 443 outbound allowed; we will open 22 for the jumpbox only from the Redwood public key set.
- Data egress concern: we will run the canary inside a private subnet with egress blocked; Redwood’s agents will need to run inside our VPC or via peered VPC.
- Monitoring: we will feed metrics to Prometheus; can Redwood ship an exporter or do you require a pull?

If those constraints are ok, we’ll sign off on the proposed canary window. Also, for the canary, can you provide a smaller test dataset (2–3 representative prompts) so we can surface regressions quickly?

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Khan
Senior SRE | Elysian Labs
samir.khan@elysianlabs.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Kate Morales <kate.morales@elysianlabs.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@elysianlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff velocity map + evaluation checkpoints — post-signature rollout (Elysian Labs)

Great — thanks everyone. Quick recap and confirmed next steps: 

- Dates: Training week June 3–7 (Marissa to send invites when Kate confirms roster). Canary execution target June 17–21. Recovery window June 24–26.
- Infra: Samir to provide list of allowed IPs/public keys by 6/3; Redwood to prepare exporter (we will provide a Prometheus push gateway option if pull is not possible).
- Acceptance: Meeting the 99.5% success / P95 < 350ms gates for two consecutive checkpoints will clear the canary to ramp.
- Deliverables this week: updated MAP v1 → v1.1 (Marissa), training roster (Kate), sample test prompts (Elysian).

I’ll schedule the recurring 30-min sync starting 5/29 and include a 15-min agenda to walk the MAP on the first call. If anyone needs an earlier short-cadence touch, ping me and I’ll set it.

Thanks again — look forward to the kickoff.

— Priyom
